levels.description: Unlock Telekinetic Burst: spend 12% maximum Mana to damage one foe for 30 + 0.5× Intelligence + 0.2× Mind (2 AP).

effects.name: Telekinetic Burst
effects.description: Spend 12% maximum Mana and 2 AP to deal 30 + 0.5× Intelligence + 0.2× Mind Basic damage to one enemy. Usable once per turn.

levels.description: Unlock Mind Barrier: spend 15% maximum Mana to gain 40% Armor and Evasion and take 15% less damage for two turns (1 AP).

effects.name: Mind Barrier
effects.description: Spend 15% maximum Mana and 1 AP for +40% Armor and Evasion and 15% less incoming damage for two turns. Once per combat.

levels.description: Unlock Psychic Lance: spend 18% maximum Mana to deal 50 + 0.6× Intelligence + 0.3× Mind damage and have a 25% chance to stun (2 AP).

effects.name: Psychic Lance
effects.description: Spend 18% maximum Mana and 2 AP to deal 50 + 0.6× Intelligence + 0.3× Mind Basic damage; 25% chance to stun for one turn. Once per combat.

levels.description: Gain Mental Pressure: Psykic skill damage +15%.

effects.name: Mental Pressure
effects.description: Damage dealt by Psykic skills increases by 15%.

levels.description: Unlock Mindstorm: spend 25% maximum Mana to damage all enemies for 40 + 0.5× Intelligence + 0.3× Wisdom and slow them by 15% for two turns (3 AP).

effects.name: Mindstorm
effects.description: Spend 25% maximum Mana and 3 AP to deal 40 + 0.5× Intelligence + 0.3× Wisdom Basic damage to all enemies, reducing their Speed by 15% for two turns. Once per combat.
